summary: TREDI pass-3 FRONTEND end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 (owner@tredi.app). All 21 More-tab rows are present with the expected testIDs and every one navigates to its screen and back. Reports hub renders all 8 tiles and each report (summary, cashflow, products, pnl, receivables, stock, sales-summary, returns) renders real figures. Period sheet works: period-bar opens, period-last_month + period-apply applies globally, and Summary's period label reflects 'Last month' (August 2026). summary-period-year switches to 'This year · 2026' with recomputed figures. Suppliers: create supplier 'Kano Grains Ltd', open supplier profile, record-purchase modal loads 14 stock items in the picker, draft add (qty 5 x cost 1000) works. Transfers full lifecycle passes: create Ikeja->Surulere with an item qty 2, transfer saves, pending list shows TRF-108 with Approve, approving moves it to In transit, opening Receive lets receive-minus reduce qty, a reason field appears via receive-reason-<lineId>, Confirm stays disabled until a reason is typed, receive-confirm succeeds and the transfer moves to Received with Discrepancy label. Quotations: create with a customer + item, list shows the new quote and quote-convert-<id> opens the freshly created invoice detail (/invoices/<id>). Invoice extras: from Sales tab, opening an unpaid invoice shows both invoice-send-reminder (reminder screen contains the invoice number 'INV-1003') and invoice-activity (opens /history/<id> with events). Invoice settings: settings-prefix/settings-vat-on/settings-save all present, save shows the 'Saved' toast. Terms: terms-add -> terms-name -> terms-save creates 'Net 30 Test' and it appears in the list. Team: 6 users load with testID team-user-<id> (NOT team-member-<id>); permissions screen renders Own/Shop/All scope segments and permissions-can-see_profit toggles + permissions-save works. Home extras: home-search opens /search and search-input returns grouped results; home-notifications opens /notifications; home-edit-shortcuts opens /shortcuts which lists 4 on-home shortcuts + 7 available, remove/add + shortcuts-save applies. home-business-switcher opens the shop switcher. Calculators: margin-cost 1000 + margin-sell 1500 -> margin-profit '₦ 500' and margin-pct '33.3% / 50.0%'; tool-vat -> vat-amount 1000 -> vat-total '₦ 1,075'; tool-discount and tool-instalments testIDs also present. Business card: card-tagline / card-style-deep / card-show-tin all present and the preview updates; NOTE the Save control is 'card-save-image', not 'card-save' as the review script expected. Import: paste 'name,phone\n...' + import-check-paste correctly classifies '1 rows are ready, 2 rows need attention' with a Blocked row (missing phone) and a Merge? row (duplicate phone). import-commit imports only the clean row: 'Done 1 customers imported'. Receipts: /documents/receipts renders 'All 4 / Not attached 1' tabs plus 'Choose photo' + 'Snap a bill' controls (camera capture itself intentionally deferred). Shops: /shops shows both branches with switchers, /shops/overview renders totals + per-shop bars + pending transfer + stock, /businesses renders active business card with 2 shops / 6 users / this-month figure. Console during full run: 0 page errors; only benign RNW warnings persist.

ui_bugs.issue: Review request expects testID 'card-save' but the file exposes 'card-save-image' and 'card-share' only. Save works, but add an alias testID='card-save' so QA scripts don't break. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/business-card.tsx:123

After shortcuts-save the mutation calls router.back(). When /shortcuts is opened via a direct URL (no history) Expo Router pops a toast "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled by any navigator". From the normal home-edit-shortcuts entry point back() works, but consider fallback: `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/shortcuts.tsx:30

action_items: LOW: Add testID='card-save' as an alias on the save button in /app/frontend/app/tools/business-card.tsx (currently 'card-save-image') so the published QA testID list matches the code.

LOW: In /app/frontend/app/shortcuts.tsx replace `router.back()` on save success with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')` to avoid the 'GO_BACK not handled' toast when the screen is opened directly.
OPTIONAL: The old shadow* RNW deprecation warning is silenced; no further action.
